paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : Wait-k Policy
model_annotation: The figure is a single line chart illustrating BLEU score as a function of Average Lagging (AL) for a wait-k policy, comparing three methods. The x-axis is labeled “Average Lagging (AL)” and appears linear with labeled ticks at 0, 2, 4, 6, and 8 (range shown approximately 0–8). The y-axis is labeled “BLEU,” uses a linear scale, and spans from about 19 to 30 with labeled ticks at 20, 22, 24, 26, 28, and 30; light gray horizontal gridlines align with these ticks. Three dashed lines with point markers are plotted: “Consistency-CE” is shown in blue with circular markers and increases across AL values, with points near BLEU ≈19 at AL ≈0.5, ≈23.8 at AL=2, ≈26.4 at AL=4, ≈27.3 at AL=6, and ≈28.6 at AL=8. “Consistency-Bi +sampling” is shown in orange with triangular markers, with points around BLEU ≈24.2 at AL ≈0.5, ≈25.9 at AL=2, ≈28.0 at AL=4, ≈28.7 at AL=6, and ≈29.4 at AL=8. “Consistency-Bi +beam” is shown in green with square markers, with points around BLEU ≈23.3 at AL ≈0.5, ≈25.2 at AL=2, ≈27.7 at AL=4, ≈28.7 at AL=6, and ≈29.4 at AL=8. A legend box placed near the lower center of the plot maps these colors and marker shapes to the three method names.
